data: Which line represents the average topic distance between the training half of the black interviewer dataset and the white interviewer dataset?

The caption provides information about the two lines in the figure. The black line is labeled as 'baseline', which corresponds to the average topic distance between the "training" half and "validation" half of the black interviewer dataset. The red dashed line is labeled as 'dist', which corresponds to the average topic distance between the "training" half of the black interviewer dataset and the white interviewer dataset. Therefore, the red dashed line represents the average topic distance between the training half of the black interviewer dataset and the white interviewer dataset.
